capabilities.title: Known legacy folder relocation

behavior.windows: Roaming locator, profile config and LocalAppData entries move to Ergopti; protected Ollama sibling remains separate.
behavior.macos: Support locator/runtime download, config, logs, cache and control entries move to native Ergopti purpose roots.
behavior.linux: Config/state/data legacy roots merge into ergopti under their XDG bases; cache is prepared.

capabilities.rationale: Maintainer-only one-time conversion; no published builds used these legacy folders. Different native purpose roots are intentional.

capabilities.title: Existing destination and immutable conflict backup

behavior.windows: Nonempty destination wins; old entry moves to backup; occupied backup retains old entry.
behavior.macos: Same shared policy; real POSIX rename can violate it on a concurrent arrival (MFM-004).
behavior.linux: Same policy; native race LFM-001 and self-alias LFM-005 qualify preservation.

capabilities.rationale: Never Overwrite is an explicit promise; known defects do not make overwrite an intentional difference.

capabilities.title: Preserve selection after moving a chosen config

behavior.windows: Exact normalized default rewriter misses descendants and quoted TOML keys (WFM-002/003).
behavior.macos: Exact text rewriter misses descendants and valid literal values (MFM-003).
behavior.linux: Moved native storage keeps paths.config_dir pointing into old root (LFM-003).

capabilities.rationale: Cross-OS selected-profile displacement has related manifestations; no intentional authorization to select fresh defaults was found.

capabilities.title: Bootstrap text rewrite backup and recovery

behavior.windows: Verified prior-text copy then in-place FSWrite; no common move/rewrite recovery (WFM-001).
behavior.macos: Prior-text backup then in-place write; existing backup can prevent restart repair (MFM-001/002).
behavior.linux: Migration does not invoke shared paths.toml rewrite; bootstrap is native JSON under new config base.

capabilities.rationale: Different bootstrap formats and owners are intentional; failed-location consistency remains an open defect.

capabilities.title: Preserve existing transition recovery namespace

behavior.windows: Boot recovers beside new locator after migration; old Roaming WAL remains outside it (WFM-004).
behavior.macos: No equivalent Windows locator-WAL adoption claim established in this bounded flow.
behavior.linux: No equivalent Windows locator-WAL adoption claim established in this bounded flow.

capabilities.rationale: The Windows durable configuration-transition journal is a specific owner; absence of an identical journal is not by itself a feature gap on other OS.

capabilities.title: Native migration directory enumeration

behavior.windows: AHK native file enumeration source-reviewed; denial/iterator behavior not executed.
behavior.macos: Native-port refusal escapes public run in Linux LFS-bound reproduction; Darwin qualification open (MFM-005).
behavior.linux: Line-framed ls splits LF names and ignores failure receipt (LFM-002/004).

capabilities.rationale: Native API mechanics differ; observed failure handling is not declared intentional.

capabilities.title: Physical root identity and symlinks

behavior.macos: Generic external-link policy remains unknown; same-root logs alias demonstrably archives active files through immutable production plan/ports (MFM-006).
behavior.linux: Generic drain policy unknown; same-root alias physically archives active files (LFM-005).

capabilities.rationale: Generic symlink follow/refuse intent is unknown: do not infer all links must be refused. Physical self-migration of current state is independently demonstrated on macOS-owner/POSIX ports and native Linux; Windows reparse behavior remains unqualified.

capabilities.title: Retained compiled/native runtime paths

behavior.windows: Managed Ollama remains a protected direct LocalAppData sibling.
behavior.macos: Compiled owned Karabiner Runtime and karabiner roots keep ErgoptiPlus; downloaded RemapRuntime moves.
behavior.linux: Native XDG root naming and distribution paths apply; no Karabiner counterpart.

capabilities.rationale: Windows ACL and macOS compiled runtime/artifact constraints are documented; unchanged names are intentional exceptions.

capabilities.title: Installed self replacement

behavior.windows: Compiled exe: verified staging, suspended worker, parent-exit handoff and boot-ready/probation.
behavior.macos: Packaged app: Sparkle newest or separate chosen-version stage/armed swap.
behavior.linux: Standalone tar install: owned complete-tree transaction; package/immutable modes refuse self replacement.

capabilities.rationale: Distribution and platform ownership constrain which installer is available. Helpers alone do not establish reachability.

capabilities.title: Source checkout updating through scoped updater

behavior.windows: Self replacement/check schedule rows disabled in local-source mode; no updater git-pull owner established.
behavior.macos: Source/DevSource updater is blocked; no in-scope source-pull owner established.
behavior.linux: Source self replacement/automatic checks disabled; no in-scope source-pull owner established.

capabilities.rationale: Preserve development/distribution ownership; this is not a claim that no other repository development command exists.

capabilities.title: Channels, scheduled checks and chosen installation

behavior.windows: Shared channel/schedule policies with native AHK acquisition/epoch owners.
behavior.macos: Shared channel/schedule plus native dispatch; manual check and Sparkle consent remain separate.
behavior.linux: Shared channel/schedule with libuv and explicit pause/currentness ownership.

capabilities.rationale: Checking and automatic download/install are distinct capabilities. A scheduled check does not authorize automatic installation.

capabilities.title: Install when only feed discovery is available

behavior.windows: Feed-only historical row has no verified asset details and cannot install through custom path.
behavior.macos: Newest offered row can hand off to Sparkle signed appcast; arbitrary historical feed rows cannot.
behavior.linux: Feed-only discovery is check-only; chosen install requires detailed release metadata.

capabilities.rationale: Atom discovery lacks archive digests; Sparkle provides a separate verifying engine on macOS. This intentional fallback difference is user-visible.

capabilities.title: Digest and signature admission

behavior.windows: Archive digest binding implemented; shared detached-signature policy is off with empty key.
behavior.macos: Chosen app requires digest/version/designated code requirement; Sparkle has independent signature policy.
behavior.linux: Archive digest binding and optional detached signature owner; current shared detached policy is off.

capabilities.rationale: Record actual disabled configuration and macOS code-sign requirements; do not advertise universal signed-update equivalence or invent a rationale for absent key provisioning.

capabilities.title: Pre-install configuration snapshot and restore

behavior.windows: Chosen-release path snapshots rules-selected files; direct update-prompt installation does not call that sequence. Restore is separate from executable rollback.
behavior.macos: Chosen-version path snapshots rules-selected files; hs.settings, Keychain and arbitrary app state excluded. Sparkle backup equivalence not qualified here.
behavior.linux: Rules-selected file snapshot, per-file conditional restore and recovery backup; not whole-machine atomic state.

capabilities.rationale: Backup scope is a file contract, not a promise to clone all native settings/secrets. Existing restore/reload findings remain in earlier audit.

capabilities.title: Terminal install/restart receipt

behavior.windows: Exact swap events, successor boot-ready and probation; canonical/recovery rollback privately replayed.
behavior.macos: ARMED-on-quit remains pending; refused exit can publish failed/idle while lease is held (MUR-001). No chosen-swap boot probation established.
behavior.linux: Transaction activates/smokes then requests restart; systemd/relay receipt is admission, not successor ready.

capabilities.rationale: Windows has a stronger successor-ready/probation contract in this chosen-release flow. No explicit rationale for the missing custom macOS/Linux receiving equivalent was established; it is not claimed impossible on either OS. ARMED-on-quit is intentional, while contradictory pending/failed state is MUR-001. Compare contract scope before implementation.

capabilities.title: Deadline and event-loop responsiveness

behavior.windows: Native worker separates replacement from live AHK; live native latency unmeasured.
behavior.macos: Owned tasks/native handoff; live AppKit/Hammerspoon latency unmeasured.
behavior.linux: Default synchronous smoke stalls the real LuaJIT loop past install deadline in a private fixture (LUR-001).

capabilities.rationale: Linux private 250ms-budget/650ms-sleeper proof demonstrates starvation; it is not a typical desktop latency measurement or proof other OS are immune.
